title: VIX1D overstates real 0DTE ATM vol by ~17%
detail: Real SPXW 0DTE ATM implied vol (backed out of real prices, model time convention) divided by VIX1D at the same moment: 0.82 (11/13), 0.86 (11/18), 0.82 (11/20), across VIX1D levels from 13 to 26. H1 used atmScale = 0.83. Without this correction the model would have credited ~20% too much premium on every trade, more than the whole cost hurdle.
